name: io.github.originchaindb/mcp-server
title: OriginChainDB
description: SQL, read-only graph, vector and full-text search tools for an OriginChainDB database.

environmentVariables.name: OC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your database's address, copied from Connect.

environmentVariables.name: OC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An access token from Access tokens.

environmentVariables.name: OC_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to make the SQL tool read-only: it then forwards only a single plain SELECT.
